stories.title: Confirmation hearing report adopted for SME minister nominee

en.title: Confirmation hearing report adopted for SME minister nominee
en.summary: A parliamentary committee adopted a confirmation hearing report for small and medium enterprises minister nominee Lee So-young with bipartisan support, clearing the way for her appointment. The opposition party expressed concerns about her fitness for the role citing unresolved apartment purchase questions and limited SME expertise.

en.title: S. Korea, US, Japan Reaffirm Commitment for N. Korea's Denuclearization, Urge Return to Dialogue
en.summary: Foreign ministers from South Korea, the United States, and Japan jointly reaffirmed their commitment to North Korea's denuclearization and called on North Korea to resume dialogue.

stories.title: Seoul stocks open sharply higher on chip gains amid revived AI hopes

en.title: Seoul stocks open sharply higher on chip gains amid revived AI hopes
en.summary: South Korean stocks opened significantly higher Tuesday driven by technology gains following strong US market performance, declining oil prices, and renewed artificial intelligence optimism. The Korea Composite Stock Price Index rose over 2 percent in early trading.

en.summary: South Korean fencers led by Song Se-ra aim for a second consecutive title in women's team epee at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. South Korean swimmers including Hwang Sun-woo and Kim Young-beom will also compete in pool events.
